notablePrerequisites:
Likeness of the Seeker and Balduvian Warlord do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature that can block Likeness of the Seeker.
description:
Cast Irresistible Prey by paying {G}, targeting Likeness of the Seeker.
Declare Likeness of the Seeker as an attacker, forcing an opponent to block it.
Likeness of the Seeker triggers, untapping Balduvian Warlord and two other lands you control.
Optionally, you may activate the lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}.
Activate Balduvian Warlord by tapping it, removing a creature blocking Likeness of the Seeker from combat, and then causing that creature to block Likeness of the Seeker.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Azusa's Many Journeys // Likeness of the Seeker
